Experience:
This review concerns CTU 6. The residents were supportive and taught interns extensively.

Advantages:
Rounds are short, usually from 9 to 11.

Tips:
Attend and present during morning meetings. See and present new patients, write notes, and ask a resident to demonstrate the process when needed.

الإيجابيات:
خفيف جدا جدا جدا مرة مفيد اذا بشهر اختبارك

Experience:
Very hectic and not suitable for studying. A large share of routine clinical work may fall to interns because many shifts are staffed by service doctors rather than program residents. Four paediatric ER rotations are usually lighter than adult ER.

Advantages:
Good knowledge and medical experience.

Disadvantages:
The workload can be heavy and includes many routine service tasks.

Experience:
This felt like the least educational general-surgery rotation. There were few opportunities to gain skills or knowledge because the team had limited time for teaching.

Disadvantages:
The respondent found little educational value in the rotation.

Experience:
Great overall, with a lot of routine work and limited learning in surgical management or practical skills.

Advantages:
Three days a week. Work starts very early, around 6:30 when surgeries begin.

Disadvantages:
Interns may be asked to obtain surgical consent before the patient has been assessed, which made the respondent uncomfortable because they could not confidently explain complications. The schedule leaves little time to study.

Tips:
The breast service may have a lighter workload than colorectal and minimally invasive surgery.

Experience:
To be honest I heard worse than my own experience. In a nutshell, it’s like any other specialty! The rounds start at 9 or 10 and finish at 11 or 12.
One day per week you have to stay until 4 for H&P.
Clinics are very hectic!

1- Rounds:
Every day. You should come and take 2-3 patients to present.
Starts at 9 or 10 and ends at 12 or 1.
You have to come early to prepare and see the patients physically; I used to come at 8.

2- Clinics:
After the rounds finish, you are free to attend the OR or clinics.

3- On-calls: 2-3
* Weekday on-calls are from 4 PM to 8 AM. Most teams had a pre- and post-call off; however, our team had to attend the pre-call rounds, so 24 hours in the hospital. You will be assigned to either wards or L&D.
* Weekend on-calls are either 8 AM to 8 PM or 8 PM to 8 AM. You will be assigned to both wards and L&D. Please be aware of that since many interns didn’t know about it.

4- Admissions:
* From each team, one person should stay until 4 to write H&Ps.
* You can find a comfortable place to stay and call to check if there is any H&P or general consent for your team.
* At 2:30 you can ask the nurses if they are expecting any admission. ER cases usually take an hour or more to arrive, so if there are no cases you can go. Don’t wait until 4 if you are sure no one is coming. If not, please stay because the on-call cases are many.

Disadvantages:
The oncalls!!! You can’t even take 5 minutes break

Tips:
Tips for Oncall:
* It is very important for the one who is responsible for the admissions during the day to make sure that AlL the cases have H/P.. so the oncall will be less hectic for his/her colleagues
* Make sure to write the note under IP not OP using admission format.. if u don’t your colleagues will have to rewrite it.
* Make sure to Co-sign the MRP.. if u don’t, also your college will have to rewrite it.
* Your role in the Oncall is to write H/P only. You will not have any brakes unfortunately.. to many cases!!

التجربة:
خفيف لطيف، التحضير بتوقيع، يحتاج نسوي برزنتيشن نهاية الشهر ونحضر السشنز اللي يسوونها

الإيجابيات:
بيئه لطيفه متعاونه، كل ثلاثاء يغدونكم، مافي مناوبه

النصائح:
مروا على اللي بيقيمكم كذا مره عشان يعرف انكم موجودين

Experience:
They expect you to perform ventilation and intubation only. Some residents may ask you to prepare medications with them, and sometimes you may not do anything, especially in difficult cases. You need to arrive between 7:30 and 7:45. After induction, you can leave for a break (usually 40 minutes) or go home, depending on the consultants and residents. Similar to the clinical attachment in COM, you must be signed off at the end of the day.

Advantages:
Maximum at 11:30-12:00 you can leave. Often, you may finish between 10:00 and 11:00, and occasionally as early as 9:00.

Experience:
Just run do not go there if you’re not interested in breast surgery, I swear they will treat you like a resident and you will be more than 8 H in the hospital everyday

Disadvantages:
Everything

Experience:
Only inpatient rounds, no OR, no clinics, no on-calls. Inpatient: mostly depends on the assistant consultant on service, but generally rounds starts around 9:30-10 and ends by 12-12:3. You will have 1-2 patients (if the team are busy you may have 3 max), you are required to assess them daily and write progress note. In case your patients need consultations you will do them, and if the team busy you may do consultation for other patients as well. Overall all associates/assistants I worked with were very respectful and kind.

Advantages:
Low patients load, no ORs or oncalls. And for sure short working hours.

Tips:
If you have an exam during your rotation tell them from the beginning, they are very understanding

Experience:
cooperative and understanding Team
Even if your not interested you'll learn alot

Advantages:
Very thorough with their tasks great especially to those interested, but generally you will learn the basics at least

Disadvantages:
Long rounds, heavy workload

Tips:
Just be respectful (generally very lenient)

Experience:
Light team, neutral experience (not bad), basic IM experience.

Advantages:
- Very light workload; rounds start at 9 and finish at 10-11, and you can go home afterward.
- The senior may ask you to write notes sometimes, but not if you’re not interested.
- The juniors I was with were very helpful and didn’t ask for help at all.

Disadvantages:
- You HAVE to sign attendance every day before 9 AM.
- You have to give notice of leave to the senior or she will call you.
- Very boring if you’re not interested ☺️..🌹 مع احترامي

Tips:
The chief resident told us to have good attitude In general and show interest to the team and be involved more.
Not interested so I don’t know..

التجربة:
هذه التجربة في الفريق الأزرق. يتغير ضغط العمل بشكل واضح حسب الاستشاري؛ في الفترات الأخف كان عدد المرضى بين ٥ و٨ وينتهي الدوام قرابة ١١، وفي الفترات المزدحمة وصل العدد إلى ١٨ وكان الانتهاء بين ٢:٣٠ و٣.

الروتيشن بشكل عام واضح وسهل. عادةً يتابع متدرب الامتياز مريضًا واحدًا ويجهز النوت ويقدمه في الراوند، وقد يتابع مريضين عند زيادة الضغط.

النصائح:
إذا كنت مهتمًا بالتخصص، بادر وشارك حتى تستفيد من الحالات.

Experience:
This review concerns Green Team, which the respondent considered one of the better teams. Interns usually follow one patient and write the post-admission or progress note. There are three on-calls, mainly involving admission notes while working with the resident on call.

Advantages:
A respectful, friendly learning environment. Consultants and residents often teach after cases, so the month can be useful even for interns who are not planning to enter paediatrics.

Disadvantages:
Feedback during presentations could be harsh, including being yelled at. The respondent’s advice was to stay calm, prepare thoroughly, and focus on the learning.

Tips:
Arrive before rounds to review the on-call note, laboratory results and your patient. Use the required infection-control precautions, examine patients carefully, and be honest about anything you could not complete.

Experience:
It was good overall. The residents were smart and active, and they weren’t really expecting that much from an intern, especially if you are not interested. They were friendly and helpful. I had very light working hours, starting from 9 AM until 12-1 PM on average. They were really cooperative overall.

Advantages:
Residents !! Especially the juniors
consultants as well

Disadvantages:
Complex cases to be honest

Tips:
Please Show good attitude even if you are not interested!! This will really help you get better treatment from the residents!!

التجربة:

السلبيات:
اذا شخص مهتم فللأسف الحالات سخيفة ومافيه تنوع. المبنى يجيب الاكتئاب

اطلبي يخلونك تمسكين عيادة. بالغالب هم اذا تعودوا على وجودك بيخلونك تمسكين

Experience:
Loved it for Non interested , very few cases in comparison to other team actually it’s the least , the round duration depends on the consultant however still it’s the least in comparison to other teams . Recommended

Experience:
It was very nice

Advantages:
Very nice and respectful doctors. Each week will be attached with a resident and they will ask you if you are interested or not sometimes if you are not interested they will not let you attend (to help you have time to study SMLE) and if you don’t like OR you can tell them and they will put you in clinics so overall the doctors are very considerate. There were no oncalls and the working hours are short and there was plenty of time to study. No sign in/ out.

Tips:
You can easily catch their attention if you are interested you can tell the residents and they will help you. In my case, I wasn’t interested so I did not care that much.

Experience:
Overall the rotation was good and easy. This experience for non intrested interns:
They divide us into 4 specialities each specialty for one week
1- Pediatric ENT: was the best of them I just attend one day
2- otology: did not attend the whole week again if you said you are not interested they will say dont come
3- H&N: this was the only speciality that really cared about attendance, not interesting, full of complicated cases, but I only attend clinics/rounds no OR
4- rhinology: only attend 2 days clinic

Advantages:
If you are not intrested they said dont come + I did not attend any OR i told them that I want clinics/rounds only

Disadvantages:
Head and neck rotation was full of complicated cases, in this rotation you are attached to a resident sometimes they will cover another specialty, in the end of rotation all interns are evaluated by one consultant this is most likely will lead to random evaluation.

Tips:
Just say you are not intrested

Experience:
This review concerns Team A. Interns are expected to see two patients and present them during rounds, although presentation opportunities are inconsistent. Rounds usually run from 9 to 11 AM, then one intern stays until 4 PM to complete admission notes. On Wednesdays there are no rounds, but one intern still covers admissions until 4 PM.

Advantages:
There is often enough time to study while covering the ward, including days with no new admissions.

Disadvantages:
It could be difficult to find someone available to complete the evaluation, so arrange it early. Team communication felt unwelcoming, and interactions with leadership were difficult.

Experience:
A light rotation with either a morning clinic from 8:00 to 11:30 or an afternoon clinic from 12:30 to 4:00. Interns initially work with a consultant or resident, then may run their own clinic and see around 2–6 straightforward follow-up cases. The weekly Down syndrome clinic can be difficult at first but becomes easier with familiarity. Attendance is monitored strictly, and missing a clinic may result in a warning even when the absence is for an appointment.

Advantages:
Supportive consultants, short working hours, useful learning and good exposure to the BestCare system.

Disadvantages:
You may need to wait 30 minutes after a patient’s appointment time even when the patient does not attend. The Down syndrome clinic can be demanding.

Tips:
Learn useful BestCare shortcuts and ask for follow-up and discharge forms to be available in F&I. Morning clinics are usually lighter; afternoon clinics may run until 4 PM and finish during rush hour.

التجربة:
تجربة رائعة ومفيدة. يتقاسم المتدربون تغطية العيادات والتنويم بينهم، بحيث تكون العيادات لفترة أقصر والتنويم لبقية الروتيشن. لا يوجد جدول ثابت؛ اتفقوا مع الفيلو في البداية على توزيع الأيام.

في التنويم تمسك مريضًا وتتابعه يوميًا وتقدمه في الراوند. إذا لم يُسند إليك مريض فبادر واطلب. يبدأ العمل عادةً قرابة ٩ وينتهي غالبًا عند ١:٣٠. أما العيادات فتكون من يومين إلى أربعة أيام حسب الأسبوع، وقد تمسك عيادة ويدخل الاستشاري الأوردرات. كل أربعاء يوجد قراند راوند من ٩ إلى ١١ يتضمن شرح موضوع ثم الراوند.

الإيجابيات:
حالات ممتعة، ودوام التنويم غالبًا من دون ضغط كبير.

السلبيات:
العيادات قد تكون مزدحمة إذا كان اليوم كاملًا.

النصائح:
تواصلوا مع الفريق في بداية الروتيشن، واطلبوا متابعة حالة مناسبة لمستواكم حتى تستفيدوا من التغيرات اليومية والخطة العلاجية.

Experience:
Great experience
8am  - 12pm shifts (give and take) and only 1 patient per intern
3 oncalls per month (patients ranged from 1 to 5)
Good month to study in
As per resident, winter is a hectic season for peds, so if your rotation happens to be during winter try and consider other hospitals. Otherwise, kasch has reasonable load

Disadvantages:
You have to wake the parents up sometimes

Tips:
Rounds start around 9 AM
I used to be at the hospital at 8 to see the patient, prepare my presenting note, and if i got extra time I could also write the progress note

Try and be opportunistic when examining babies before they cry

Experience:
This review concerns Team D. Interns were expected to select and follow patients without a clear distribution between residents and interns. Teaching varied by consultant: it was limited on some rounds but useful and case-based on others.

Advantages:
Rounds-only days often finish around 12–1 PM. When covering admissions until 4 PM, the workload may be light enough to study, with around 0–3 admissions. Clinic-day admission coverage can also be light.

Disadvantages:
Some rounds are long. On-calls can be hectic and admissions may arrive together; weekend shifts cover both wards and labour and delivery. Residents were often too busy to teach, and the working environment could sometimes feel unsupportive.

Tips:
Confirm the team’s pre-call and post-call policy early, and agree on patient and admission responsibilities at the start of the rotation.

Experience:
It depends on your senior resident, which changes every month. We wrote notes and did some consults, and it was enjoyable.

Advantages:
Finishing no later than 1pm and overall very light rotation

Disadvantages:
You have to sign attendance every day before 9 am

Experience:
On Team A, communication was inconsistent: interns could be criticized for not presenting even when they were not given an opportunity.

Advantages:
Interested interns can learn from varied operating-room and clinic cases. Rounds often finish around 10:30–11, followed by a limited number of admission histories, which may leave time to study.

Disadvantages:
On-call shifts could be so busy that there was little time to rest and admissions remained outstanding.

Tips:
Prepare two cases for morning rounds and tell the team early if you are interested in obstetrics and gynaecology.

التجربة:
للمهتم بالتخصص، قد تساعدك الروتيشن على التعرف إلى الفريق قبل المقابلات، لكن الفائدة التعليمية كانت محدودة في هذه التجربة.

الإيجابيات:
العمل سهل ولا يحتاج إلى تحضير كبير.

السلبيات:
المناوبات من ٤:٣٠ إلى ١٠:٣٠ مساءً، ولا يوجد مكان مخصص للمتدربين للجلوس؛ وقد يُطلب منهم مغادرة غرفة المناوبة.

Experience:
On Red Team, rounds were short, usually about an hour from 8:30. Depending on the senior resident, interns might need to stay for a noon or 2 PM recap, and consultant availability varied during the rotation. Interns may review 1–3 patients before rounds and present them if interested.

Advantages:
Plenty of time to study, no sign-in or sign-out, and no on-calls. Consultants asked teaching questions without making the environment uncomfortable, and residents were generally supportive unless the service became very busy.

Tips:
Tell the team if you are interested and volunteer to present in front of the consultant.

Experience:
-Overally very good.
-You will have time to study and time to meet the patient.
-Decent amount of exposure.
-pediatric is low flow you could have 3 pt in the whole shift, adult is a bit more hectic.
-you will have a mix of shifts, some with pediatrics, some with adults, you can’t choose one.

Advantages:
-very accommodating teams.
-mostly light shifts.
-you can study during the shift and accomplish especially in pediatrics.
-you will go home without being drained.

Disadvantages:
-They mostly want you to write the note and do the dirty work.
-Associate consultants are the one who will work with you mostly, so they won’t have time to discuss the case properly if the shift is heavy. You can work with residents and honestly I had better discussions with SOME of them.
-If you have night shift or morning shift during weekdays, you are expected to attend the morning meeting, it can be long or short depending on who’s presenting, max was 45 minutes😅. يعني تخيلوا خلصتوا دوام الليل وتجلس زياده عشان يتناقشون…

Tips:
-You will have 18 shifts, you can make it 16 shifts if you apply for leave beforehand.
-not interested so IDK about recommendation letters.

Experience:
Highly depends on the junior you're attached with, they really appreciate the “chain of command”, so your only communication with the team will be through the juniors. Your tasks are pretty easy, (morning round> notes> home) you also might be asked to do some consents for radiology, consents PICC line insertion/removal. Some will let you remove JP drains and surgical clips.

Advantages:
No oncalls (you're only required to do one weekend round; Friday&Saturday), pretty good working hours

Disadvantages:
Some days are expected to be hectic, especially if the junior is in the OR, you’ll be doing all the ward stuff

Tips:
Do your evaluation early, you’re not going to see the consultant everyday

التجربة:
يختلف الاهتمام بالمتدرب من طبيب لآخر؛ بعضهم يهتم بالحضور والمشاركة الفعالة، لكن العمل في الباطنة متعب.

النصائح:
احضر اجتماع نهاية اليوم، وكن مستعدًا وسريعًا في تنفيذ المطلوب.

Experience:
Very light rotation; the team was very cooperative and nice. You are generally responsible for two patients.

Advantages:
8 am - 12 pm max, a lot of time to study,

Tips:
be punctual, participate in the round, know everything about your patient

Experience:
very nice rotation, easy and light work

Advantages:
a lot of time to study, consultants will sign and give you permission to leave if you're not interested.

Disadvantages:
horrible location

Tips:
ask for a clinic if you are interested, let them know since day 1

Experience:
all the drs were very nice, very light rotation.

Advantages:
9 am - 12 pm max, you will be assigned 2 patients to present in the round. a lot of time to study.

Tips:
let them know you're not interested early on

Experience:
honestly, high load of patients, interns work as much as residents do.

Advantages:
very informative and fun. you will meet and work with great consultants

Disadvantages:
no time to study whatsoever, shifts are very hectic so I usually leave with 0 energy for the rest of the day. You will also do all the dirty work, like consultations, consents, etc.. wouldn't recommend if you have an exam on that month.

Experience:
Hectic but I learned alot during my rotation

Advantages:
Respectful and cooperative environment , being involved with the team

Disadvantages:
Long hours of work , hectic and overcrowded and too much work , some patients are difficult

Tips:
Work as hard as you can if you are interested, otherwise do what you’re obligated to do, and most importantly is to ask about anything you’re uncertain of especially when it’s about your patient, your senior has to know everything!
Being in ER and handling every patient means that you’re a part of the team , so act like one

Experience:
The workload varies between acute and critical care.

Critical care:
When there are no assigned patients there may be time to study. Interns can take histories from families, examine non-urgent cases, assist with primary surveys and reassess patients.

Acute care:
Patient load and independence vary widely by team, from a few patients to more than 10 in a shift. Some shifts allow interns to manage cases, arrange consultations and review investigations. On others, routine coordination work leaves less time for learning.

Advantages:
Strong exposure to history taking, physical examination, ultrasound and communication with patients and the wider healthcare team.

Disadvantages:
Teaching and autonomy vary by shift. Interns may be assigned routine coordination tasks or asked to arrange consultations for patients they have not personally assessed. Shift work can leave little time to study and disrupt sleep.

Tips:
Be proactive and ask to take part in clinical work.

Experience:
A strong learning experience that substantially improved history taking, physical examination and communication with patients and nurses. Interns present each case to the senior resident and may independently assess around five patients per shift, depending on workload.

Advantages:
The teams were helpful, and residents made time to teach when asked even during busy shifts. The schedule included 17 shifts, leaving several days off.

Disadvantages:
Interns are expected to complete histories, examinations, consultations and orders. Shifts usually last the full eight hours, leaving little time to study, and some patients can be challenging. Punctuality is enforced, so arrive early enough to find parking.

Tips:
Practise history and examination skills, ask for feedback on your notes, and request a break when needed.

Experience:
Excellent for everyone, if you want to learn and gain more clinical experience, if you are interested there will be a lot of chances to prove yourself, if you want to spend your time studying you’ll have a LOT of time.

Working hours 9-12 approximately
Except:
Monday: 2-3 PM there will be a lecture with monitored attendance.
Tuesday: half day for the residents so the consultant might ask you to stay for closing rounds (4-5PM)

1 or 2 oncalls per months and it’s not 24hrs

Advantages:
Understanding consultants and seniors

Disadvantages:
Difficult cases mostly bed bound patients with non favorable prognosis

Tips:
Avoid being late and leaving without permission, no need for that

التجربة:
هذه التجربة في CTU 9. تعتمد التجربة على الفريق، لكن أغلب الرزدنتس متعاونون. يمكن الاستئذان من السينير عند وجود موعد، مع أهمية عدم الغياب أو التأخر دون عذر. يختلف مستوى التدريس والتفاعل مع الاستشاريين.

المناوبات إما مناوبتان من ٥ إلى ١١ مساءً أو مناوبة واحدة في نهاية الأسبوع من ٩ إلى ١١، وقد يسمح الفريق بالمغادرة مبكرًا حسب ضغط العمل.

الإيجابيات:
العمل خفيف غالبًا؛ تحضر الراوند وتتابع مريضًا أو مريضين وتكتب النوتس، وينتهي العمل قرابة ١.

السلبيات:
التجربة تعتمد كثيرًا على الفريق والرزدنتس الموجودين.

النصائح:
وضّح اهتمامك واحتياجاتك التعليمية لقائد المسار في بداية الروتيشن.

Experience:
Enjoyable experience. Very light work for interns. Great residents and consultants.

Advantages:
Great doctors. You finish by 12 PM. Light/no work for interns unless interested.

Disadvantages:
Mandatory morning signing before 9 AM. Too many patients in the round.

Tips:
Choose a resident and stick with them.

التجربة:
حلوه

الإيجابيات:
نمشي على المرضى المنومين وخلالها نجهز اي موضوع مع الرزدنت ونقعد نتناقشه، نبدأ ٩ وننتهي حول ١١، إذا الرزدنت عندهم اختبارات نساعد في كتابة النوت، بس اذا ما عندهم نطلع، المناوبة مره وحده بالشهر إذا بنهاية الأسبوع او مرتين إذا ايام الاسبوع

التجربة:
خفيف مرة ما يدققون عالحضور كل المطلوب منك تشك لست تعبيها

الإيجابيات:
خفيف بس اهم شي اجمعوا تواقيع بالبداية عشان تسحبون براحتكم

النصائح:
احضروا بالبداية اجمعوا تواقيع واللي انترستد يحاول يمر على كل الدكاترة

Experience:
The main issue was communication about the next day’s start time; sometimes the schedule was still unclear late in the evening.

Advantages:
The team may allow interns to leave when the day’s work is complete. On-call attendance could sometimes be shortened or excused after discussing it with the junior resident.

Disadvantages:
There was no reliable advance schedule, so interns had to ask about timing day by day.

Tips:
Present during rounds, ask for the schedule early, and avoid overstepping your role.

Experience:
No attendance sheet to sign, no on-calls. Most consultants were on leave and the schedule wasn’t always on-time , but mostly Sunday is for round. Monday+ Wednesday for OR. Tuesday+ Thursday for Clinic/ wards. Tasks include writing progress notes + consultations. They usually let you go after getting the job done (usually around 12).

Advantages:
Good practical skills exposure if you are interested (OR/nurse clinic). Working hours depend on you, you can leave once you are done with the tasks. The environment is friendly and they are generous and cooperative.

Disadvantages:
In some heavy days they might ask you to stay to 3-5 pm to do consultations. But they are understanding if u have a valid reason to leave work early. How much heavy days are we talking about here? U will never know, It may happen once, twice or never انت وحظك

Tips:
Do whatever they ask you to do, because usually they gonna reward you later by making you leave early or giving you a day off. Generally, the senior staff of vascular are nice and respectful doctors.

التجربة:
أسبوعان في العيادات الخارجية، وفيهما أربع عيادات أسبوعيًا، ثم أسبوعان في الاستشارات مع رزدنت أو فيلو وراوند مع استشاري. تتابع مريضًا وتقدمه وتكتب النوت بنفسك.

الإيجابيات:
الفريق متعاون. اليوم الكامل طويل لكنه يترك بعض الوقت للدراسة. توجد جلسة تعليمية صباح الأربعاء، ولا توجد مناوبات. المكان مناسب للمهتمين بالتخصص.

السلبيات:
حصل بعض الارتباك في البداية ولم يكن توزيع المتدربين واضحًا. كان التقييم صارمًا، وقد تُخصم درجات.

النصائح:
من السهل أن تطلب إدارة عيادة بنفسك إذا كنت مهتمًا.

Experience:
A demanding urology rotation. History and physical forms must be ready before the 7:15 round, and the day rarely finishes before 3 PM. The workload is stressful but provides strong exposure to BestCare and clinical documentation.

Advantages:
Useful insight into a surgical resident’s work, with opportunities to observe or perform tasks such as urinary catheter insertion, endoscopy, cystoscopy and stent-related procedures under supervision. Some residents were welcoming and enjoyable to work with.

Disadvantages:
The rotation had long hours, many on-calls and notes, unpredictable departure times, and limited teaching on some days.

Tips:
Robotic operating lists, day care and operating-room attendance can be lengthy, so prioritise them when they match your learning goals and clarify expectations with the team.

Experience:
It was a difficult rotation especially if you are not interested, oncalls were 6 and then they were changed to 4 oncalls, its a 24 hrs oncall system, the residents are nice and helpful but it is a tough rotation if you have an upcoming exam

Advantages:
You can learn how to foley caths, irritations, flushing, stent removals and cystoscopies

Disadvantages:
Long working hours from 6:30 AM to 2/3 PM with 24 hr oncalls and your post call starts 12 pm the next day

Tips:
If you’re interested try to help the residents as much as you can as they need help

التجربة:
هذه الروتيشن في جراحة الثدي وتمتد بين مدينة الملك عبدالعزيز الطبية ومستشفى صحة المرأة. التجربة مفيدة لكنها متعبة؛ يتحمل المتدرب مهامًا قريبة من مهام الرزدنت مثل كتابة النوتس وبعض الأوردرز وإدارة العيادة وتجهيز المرضى. يتناوب المتدربون بين أسابيع العمليات والعيادات.

في أسبوع العمليات يبدأ العمل بالراوند وتجهيز ملاحظات الدخول وبعض أوامر ما بعد العملية والخروج والاستشارات. المشاركة داخل غرفة العمليات محدودة عند الازدحام، لكن يمكن طلب السكرب إذا كنت مهتمًا. في أسبوع العيادات تتعلم في البداية مع الرزدنت، ثم قد تمسك عيادة وتعرض المريضة على الاستشاري لكتابة الخطة.

ساعات أسبوع العمليات تقريبًا من ٧ صباحًا إلى ٤–٦ مساءً، والعيادات من ٨ صباحًا إلى ٤–٥ مساءً. توجد أيضًا مناوبات مع الجراحة العامة ويختلف عددها حسب الجدول.

الإيجابيات:
الأجواء متعاونة عمومًا، ويمكن سؤال الرزدنت عن أي مهمة جديدة. مستوى الإشراف والاهتمام بالمتدربين يختلف من يوم إلى آخر.

السلبيات:
الدوام طويل ويترك وقتًا قليلًا للمذاكرة. قد تقل فرص العمل داخل العمليات عند الازدحام، وقد تُسند للمتدرب مهام إضافية كان يُتوقع أن ينفذها الرزدنت.

النصائح:
استفد من التعرض للجراحة والعيادات، واسأل بوضوح عن أي مهمة لا تعرفها.

Experience:
So in brief I was not interested in the specialty so they usually left me alone but once every 3 days they will let me have a few patients and practice my hx taking. But if you’re interested they will give you teaching sessions and you’ll have more patients

Advantages:
-Practicing your history taking
- lots of time to study ( even if you leave and come back nobody will notice you 🫠)
- nice team everyone was helpful
- If you want there’s teaching sessions

Disadvantages:
- Not much to do around
- you’ll see a verity of patients mostly elderly and difficult or confused and anxious
- you’ll need a consultant permission to leave even if it’s 4 PM

Tips:
Stay close to the consultants go with them in every clinic
ask any questions you have
show that you’re interested and ask them for the letter don’t wait for them to act

Experience:
Since it is random basically  it is like the clincal attachment that we used to have ij college 😏you know

Advantages:
Max. At 12 you can leave

Disadvantages:
Pooring to just stand in the OR DONING NOTHING BUT OBSERVING , however some doctor give us thaw chance to leave to study and come baco others do not

Tips:
Must to attend first weeks so that consultants and doctors are familiar with you regarding your evaluation you have to ask the chief resident ealry who will take care of the evaluation is it one doctor or randome

Experience:
Excellent experience if you’re interested. You’ll be taking over a clinic just like a resident.

Advantages:
Great doctor - No days off, three days half, 2 days full - plenty of time during working hours can be utilized for studying

Tips:
Make sure you sign your attendance at the secretary office on the first floor

department: Paediatric hepatobiliary and liver transplant surgery
body:
التجربة:
رغم أنه تخصص جراحي، فهو سهل ومريح جدًا. أغلب الفريق متعاون، ولست مقيدًا بجدول معين؛ لا يلزم حضور العمليات أو العيادة، والمطلوب الأساسي هو حضور الراوند ومتابعة حالة أو حالتين وكتابة ملاحظات المتابعة. الدوام خفيف غالبًا، يبدأ الساعة ٩ وينتهي ١١ أو ١٢. أحيانًا يتأخر الراوند، وأحيانًا يبدأ مبكرًا إذا كان الفريق مشغولًا.

النصائح:
إذا كنت مهتمًا بالتخصص فأخبرهم من البداية، فقد يعطونك مهام وفرصًا إضافية.

Experience:
A positive clinic-based rotation with teaching from fellows and consultants. Endocrinology clinics offered a wider range of cases, while diabetes follow-up clinics could become repetitive. First-visit clinics were particularly useful for taking a complete history and understanding referrals.

Advantages:
Morning clinics run around 8:30–11:30 or noon, and afternoon clinics around 12:30–4. Interns are usually observers, but fellows may encourage them to take histories and present patients. On busy days, interns may be offered their own clinic with consultant approval.

Disadvantages:
There are internal-medicine on-calls, usually two weekdays or one weekend. If you only observe in clinic, the work can become repetitive.

Tips:
Attend consistently with a small number of consultants so they can assess your work. Ask to take histories and present patients; first-visit clinics provide the best practice.

Experience:
Cooperative team, helpful and short rounds most of the days

Advantages:
Short working hours rounds start 9/9:30 ends 11-1pm

Disadvantages:
Fellow asks a lot of question, you should be prepared to present your case and know every detail

Tips:
Always show interest even if your not interested

Experience:
This review concerns Complex Team. The experience varied with staffing: one assignment was friendly and allowed earlier departure, while another was stricter and generally finished around 12–1 PM. Rounds began around 9–9:30, with some preparation required from 8 AM.

Advantages:
Respectful doctors and occasional useful teaching.

Disadvantages:
The experience can differ substantially depending on the team.

Tips:
Finish assigned tasks promptly, remain professional, and be clear about your learning goals.

Experience:
Loved it!! Suits ppl who are not interested, you take one patient per day and finish the round around 11:30-12

Advantages:
Nice doctors, helpful teaching during the round and absolutely short working hours

Disadvantages:
3 on calls but it’s not an disadvantage in my opinion

Tips:
If you’re interested, choose a higher-load team. They see more patients and finish around 2:45-3, I guess

According to the residents, the working hours are short and not heavy because it’s the summer time and you don’t want to try in in winter season because most children get sick that time

Experience:
it was good

Advantages:
Good teaching

Disadvantages:
Long rounds , 3 oncalls , No Postcall

Tips:
I recommend going with a lower-load team because it gets fewer patients

Experience:
Very great! Loved it very much. There are 3 shifts (7am-3pm) (3pm-11pm) (11pm-7am) each shift differs in the amount of patients and you should cover them equally so 6 shifts each and you need a signature for attendance at the end of each shift

Advantages:
Doctors and fellows are very nice, friendly, and ready to help. Working hours depends on the consultants/ fellows they may let you leave early or you can ask them and it depends whether they’re ok with you leaving or not. ((((You can absolutely study all day if you want, no one will ask about you or ask you to see patients)))) so it depends on what you would like to do 100%

Disadvantages:
Maybe thats its 8 hours shift (if you attend them all without leaving early) but even with that you can study all 8 hours no one will notice or ask about you

Tips:
Read the room, so if you’re 2 hours in your shift its a bit disrespectful to ask to leave early. If they’re busy its better not to bother them by leaving.

Experience:
A positive experience with an acceptable workload.

Advantages:
Consultants and fellows were friendly and helpful. Teaching was most consistent with paediatric residents; work with residents from other specialties could be more documentation-focused. Shifts often ended about an hour early, leaving time to study.

Disadvantages:
The afternoon shift was the busiest; morning and night shifts were usually lighter.

Experience:
Great team, cooperative, helpful

Advantages:
Alot of time to study, cooperative teams

Disadvantages:
Haven’t faced any الحمدلله

Tips:
Introduce yourself each endorsement, familiarize yourself with Pediatrics most common conditions i.e. gastroenteritis, URTI, constipation, laryngeomalacia

Experience:
Overall, a good experience with a low-to-medium workload. Consultants generally let interns choose how actively to participate. Teaching was most consistent with paediatric residents; shifts with residents from other specialties could be more documentation-focused. Depending on workload, interns may ask to leave 1–2 hours early.

Advantages:
There is plenty of time to study unless the shift is unusually busy.

Disadvantages:
The team changes frequently. Communication with some residents from other specialties could feel disrespectful, and their shifts could offer less teaching.

Tips:
Where possible, schedule similar shifts through most of the week to reduce disruption to your sleep cycle, and ask to work with paediatric residents when teaching is your priority.

Experience:
Very easy and interesting, 3 weeks are clinics and 1 week is inpatient

Advantages:
Short working hours, days off since there are only 3 clinics most weeks

Experience:
A rich rotation that teaches how to approach rheumatological disease in children, communicate with families, work in a team, write notes and perform examinations. The team was helpful and gave constructive feedback.

Advantages:
Consultants offered scheduled case-teaching sessions, and fellows helped interested interns participate in clinics. Working hours can vary; the usual workload may include full-day clinics, inpatient care, consultations and day-care coverage. There is a teaching meeting every Sunday.

Disadvantages:
The content may feel advanced for someone seeking only a general overview.

Tips:
Ask for feedback, attend teaching sessions, volunteer to follow patients or join a clinic, help the team and arrive early.

Experience:
This rotation covers general paediatrics, Down syndrome and congenital-disease clinics. Morning clinics run from 8 to 12 and afternoon clinics from 12:30 to 3:30. Interns may initially be attached to a resident, but when no resident is available they may run a clinic of 3–6 patients as resident cover.

Advantages:
Clinic work only, with no inpatient service. Cases are generally straightforward, hours are fixed, and there are useful opportunities to learn without full-day clinics.

Disadvantages:
The Down syndrome clinic can be difficult to keep up with when initial instructions are limited. There are also three on-calls with general paediatrics.

Tips:
Clarify your system access and expected clinic responsibilities at the start of the rotation.

Experience:
In general the specialty is based on your own willingness to work ( meaning if you wanna study or have something to be done you can not attend and do your work) however, the specialty itself is kinda simple so you would have inpatient, outpatient, and consultation those three would be distributed through the mnth so 1st week would be inpatient next week outpatient and so on. The dr are amazing they would let you do what ever you wish meaning if you wanna take patients you can do, but if you wanna observe this is also valid. There is no attendance. Butttt preferably attend to the consultant that you wanna be evaluated by since they do see you and it does make a difference in the score.

Advantages:
No attendance, extremely nice drs, there is time to study, only one morning meeting on sun

Tips:
If interested be there in every morning meeting, take patients, ask proper questions, have good attitude, and the attendance is cruciallllll they do see you

Experience:
On Team B, workload may become heavier when consultant coverage is reduced. The team was respectful and fellows and residents led teaching sessions.

Advantages:
Exposure to rare and complex congenital cases, with opportunities for teaching and research. On lighter days, interns may attend rounds and return later to reassess an assigned patient.

Disadvantages:
Work starts around 6:45–7:30 AM and may finish between 3 and 5 PM. On-call work includes weekday and weekend shifts arranged among interns. Clinic and operating-room days leave little time to study.

Tips:
Present cases in the Thursday teaching round and during morning rounds, and be proactive during on-calls.

Experience:
Very engaging environment, inpatient they will assign you patients to present during the round. Clinic which is the most place you will learn from! they will let you to see patients on your own room ( history , examination, writing notes) then the consultant will come and you are going to present the case usually the consultant will repeat some questions and do the examination again, then will tell you the plan to write on the note (we can’t order medications or do referrals so there is a doctor on the clinic area only for orders which you will tell him/her the orders after each patient)

Advantages:
Very respectful and nice

Disadvantages:
In comparison to others it has a long working hours most of the days from 8am to 4pm, and sometimes the clinic is so busy and you would see around 6-8 patients, but they understand that you are an intern and will let you take your time.

Tips:
Avoid being late

التجربة:
الروتيشن خفيف، ولا يطلب من المتدربين كتابة نوتات أو متابعة مرضى؛ الدور غالبًا بالملاحظة، وقد توجد أيام راحة حسب التغطية.

الإيجابيات:
التعامل مع الأطفال جميل، والفريق لطيف ومتعاون.

النصائح:
استغل الوقت في الملاحظة واطلب المشاركة إذا كنت مهتمًا بالتخصص.

التجربة:
هذه التجربة في الفريق B. توجد أربعة فرق، والعمل موزع بين عيادة أسبوعية، ويوم للعمليات والراوند، وثلاثة أيام للراوند. يبدأ الراوند عادةً الساعة ٩ وينتهي قرابة ١١، لكن يلزم الحضور مبكرًا لاختيار حالة وتجهيزها للعرض. في معظم الأيام يبقى متدرب واحد حتى الساعة ٤ لتغطية حالات الدخول الجديدة.

الإيجابيات:
ملاحظات الدخول تركز على التاريخ المرضي والفحص، ولا يُطلب من المتدرب كتابة الخطة أو إدخال الأوامر. حضور العيادة والعمليات مفيد لمن يريد إثبات اهتمامه والاستفادة من الحالات.

السلبيات:
كانت ملاحظات الدخول تُسند أساسًا إلى المتدربين. توجد مناوبات في الولادة أو الأجنحة: مناوبتان في أيام الأسبوع من ٤ مساءً إلى ٨ صباحًا، ومناوبة في نهاية الأسبوع لمدة ١٢ ساعة. قد تكون الولادة أخف من الأجنحة، لكن عدد الحالات قد يكون مرتفعًا في المكانين.

النصائح:
جهّز أكثر من حالة للعرض في الراوند إذا كنت مهتمًا، واتفق مع الفريق على حضور العمليات والمهام المطلوبة.

Experience:
It was a decent experience, no loads of work, approximately 1-2 patients assigned to each intern every week (mostly 1 only).

Interns have to see the patient before the morning round, take history and do a physical examination.

The intern will have to present the case in details for the first time, and just briefly after (updates on the case).

The intern will have to write all the notes, admission, progress, and discharge notes; for the assigned patient.

Advantages:
Post-admission rounds every other day at 8:00 AM.

Morning rounds at 9:30 AM.

Closing rounds at 2:00 PM, sometimes 2:30 PM, and they only take 15-20 minutes.

There’s time to study from 11-2.

Residents were very helpful and respectful. Consultants are very informative.

Tips:
Make sure you let the consultant know about your interest and if you want a recommendation letter from day 1.

Questions will mostly be directed at you in that sense.

Make sure you ask about the proper way to write the notes, the residents will send you examples.

Experience:
There was usually time to study, although operating-room days were longer. On-call work could continue until around 10 PM.

Advantages:
The upper-GI service had a relatively low workload. The hospital was clean, had a library and offered convenient parking. Attendance monitoring was reportedly light, and there were three on-calls.

Disadvantages:
The working environment could sometimes feel unsupportive. The 8 AM morning meeting offered limited value to this respondent, while the acute-care service had a high workload.

Tips:
Be clear about your learning goals, tell your resident before leaving, and attend all scheduled on-calls.

التجربة:
انا صراحه خذيت ال GS هنا عشان ابي ارتاح واذاكر فا اللي حاب يجتهد ويثبت نفسه غالباً كلامي ماراح يفيدك فا اللي يبي يرتاح بالجي اس يعتبر خيار كويس وفي بعض الفرق أغلب الأيام تطلع بدري وبعض الايام مايكون فيه مرضى اصلا فا مايكون فيه دوام بس توقع ان تخلي احد يوقع عنك وخلاص (باقي التيمز ماعرف بالضبط كيف بس حسب اللي اعرفه ان وضعهم كويس ومافي كرف ودوام طويل) الاونكولات غالبا يمشونك

الإيجابيات:
الدكاتره كويسين كلهم صراحه، عندك وقت تذاكر للاختبار، ساعات الدوام تعتبر مب طويله

Experience:
Good center and nice doctors

Advantages:
Great if you want to save time on transportation and choose something close to you, attendance depeneds on which PHC you choose but most are easy going and you can skip if the evalautor Is not attending so you can study

Tips:
Tell them if you are not interested and ask how many shifts each week and specify that you want to study if not interested

Experience:
A well-organised schedule was sent each Saturday, with interns assigned to a different consultant each day and sometimes two in one day. The centre may suit someone who prioritises a short commute, but interns were not assigned their own clinics.

Advantages:
Most weeks included a day off. Attendance used a paper sign-in and sign-out sheet.

Disadvantages:
Learning opportunities were often limited even when interns showed interest. Interns were not assigned clinics, and some were asked to leave rather than participate. Attendance policies differ between primary-care centres, so check expectations in advance.

Tips:
Choose the centre mainly if its location is convenient, and ask early for specific learning opportunities.

التجربة:
التجربة كانت خفيفة، وكان من الممكن الاتفاق مع الإشراف على تخصيص وقت للمذاكرة بدل الحضور المنتظم.

الإيجابيات:
مناسبة لمن يحتاج إلى وقت إضافي للمذاكرة ولا يرغب في التخصص.

النصائح:
إذا لم تكن مهتمًا بالتخصص وتحتاج وقتًا للمذاكرة، ناقش ذلك مع المشرف من البداية واتفق معه بوضوح على الحضور المطلوب.

Experience:
1. benign environment
2. very high load, HPB surgery is super busy, lots of patients are referred to KFMC for this specialty, specifically
3. 3 oncalls (start from 7:30am till 12 pm next day ;) )
4. one weekend round (3 h maximum for each day)
5. morning round start between 6 - 7:30 am depending on the load at that day
6. you're responsible for writing notes "progress, admission, ex.." everyday, taking consent, Booking an appointment "OPD or radio" ....
7. scrubbing in is not mandatory, but you need at least to scrub in half the rotation
8. they don't care if you are not interested, you have to do your job, even on-calls

Advantages:
1. benign environment, رائعين جدا اخلاق فوق الطبيعي
2. interesting onco cases
3. sometimes you will do a consultation on your own, this taught me hospital manners and consultation protocols
4. mistakes are acceptable, and sometimes welcomed
5. they love interns
6. kfmc locations is super nice كل شي حولك مب زي الحرس، مو مهم بس يعني, لكن سيء وقت رجعة المدارس لان الطرق بتكون زحمه
7. they will ask you if you want to scrub in in EVERY Procedure, which is good if you are interested
8. case presentation in the morning round is easy and direct, they don't want details

Disadvantages:
1. working hours is crazy
2. 6 am rounds is common
3. cant leave before 4:30 pm
4. lots of work sometimes i cant even sit for an hour to study ;(
5. they don't care if you have exams, you cant leave early
6. they dont care if you are not interested, you still have to work
7. Weekend round! it could start early in the morning or 10/11 am, depending on the senior, never exceed 3 hours “for males: u can pray jummah in the hospital’ mosque”
7. parking is 2 riyal per hour, if you want free parking you need to park outside the hospital area, a 5-10 min walk depending on your location

Tips:
1. never leave without telling your junior
2. be social, they love interns who interact with them
3. on on-calls, ask the junior if you can leave early, they may lit you leave at least before 12 am

Experience:
A very light rotation with half-day morning clinics from 8 to 12 or afternoon clinics from 12 to 4. The centre is small but adequately equipped. Attendance was not formally recorded during this experience, and interns were not consistently included in the weekly schedule.

Advantages:
Friendly staff, a light patient load, straightforward cases, time to study, optional teaching sessions and nearby parking.

Disadvantages:
There was limited opportunity to run a clinic independently. Traffic can be heavy because the centre is close to King Fahad Road, and food or drink shops are not nearby. The first week may be confusing without a clear schedule.

Tips:
Ask to be added to the weekly schedule and clarify attendance and learning opportunities at the start.

Advantages:
Respectful nice helpful and considerate doctors, short hours due to a low work load in comparison to MNGHA so plenty of time to study, no teaching sessions but there are teaching opportunities if you asked for.

Disadvantages:
The 7:30 mandatory morning meeting, there is an attendance sheet that is closely monitored and removed at 7:40. Also a general idea at KFSH IM is that they really care if you are interested or not in the speciality as if they’re saying why come if you’re not interested, which is not a disadvantage to some. They still wouldn’t refuse that you attend their rounds or ask questions.

Tips:
Present a lot of cases and show initiative.
